meta.title: Bulmeong · Virtual campfire with crackling fire sounds
title.name: Bulmeong
title.tagline: A campfire that stays lit in your browser
title.desc: Tap the fire to make it grow. Write down what's weighing on you and throw it in to burn it. There are twenty hidden words, and each one changes the flames.
title.live: Things other people burn fly into this fire too
hud.stageTitle: See how big the fire is now
dying.text: The fire's almost out. Add firewood or tap the fire a few times. Some flames only wake up at times like this.
ticker.idle: Tap the fire to make it grow. Drag something from below into the fire.
ticker.burnedGold: Your wish on gold paper went into the fire
item.resign: A resignation letter carried around for ages
item.stock: A stock account stuck at a loss
drag.label: {item} · drop it on the fire
sheet.label: Paper to write on and burn
sheet.guide: When you're done, swipe the paper up to throw it in the fire
sheet.ph: Write down whatever you want to burn. Hidden words change the flames.
sheet.phGold: Write a wish you want to come true.
sheet.hint: Swipe up to drop it in the fire
gold.oracle: The wish on the gold paper rode the sparks up into the sky.

audio.off: Sound off · tap to turn it on

album.empty: No flames found here yet. Pick a hint, write it on the paper and throw it in.
album.noFirst: No one has found this yet

stage.0.desc: The fire's almost out. Tap it a few times to bring it back.
stage.2.desc: Just the right size for warming your hands.
stage.3.desc: The flames are getting pretty big.
stage.4.desc: A column of fire shoots into the sky.
stage.5.desc: Who let it get this big? It's about to touch the sky.
stage.revive: The dying fire came back to life.
start.msg: The fire's lit. Tap it to make it bigger, or drag something from below and throw it in.
wood.thrown: You added firewood. The fire flares up.
space.camp.desc: A rainy night in a clearing among the pines
space.temple.desc: A mountain temple in the rain, a wind chime ringing under the eaves
space.snow.desc: Outside a mountain cabin as the snow falls
space.cosmos.desc: The edge of the universe, where stardust drifts
room.work.name: Work
room.work.caption: Overtime, the commute, thoughts of quitting
room.work.rankings: The resignation letter I never handed in
My team lead pinging me on chat
A paycheck that came and went
room.work.chips: The resignation letter I'm sitting on
room.work.oracles: You switched off the office lights on your way out. The only fire left to tend is this one.
This wood burned up the sighs you held in today.
Paychecks come and go. The calm you held on to tonight stays.
Leave tomorrow's work to tomorrow's you. For now, let it go.
room.stock.name: Investing
room.stock.caption: Losing positions and late-night charts
room.stock.rankings: The chart that drops the moment I buy
My finger that bought the top
The stock that rose right after I sold
Sleepless nights watching the US market
room.stock.chips: The finger that bought the top
room.stock.oracles: That old peak is already ash. Sleep comes before your account.
Your fingertips went cold over those losses. Warm them here before you go.
The market can shake all it wants. You don't have to shake with it.
Where the greed burned off tonight, a steadier head will be waiting tomorrow.
room.relation.name: People
room.relation.caption: Tiring relationships and late-night cringe
room.relation.rankings: The late-night text I shouldn't have sent
A relationship where I always lose out
Words I held back to keep the peace
Cringe moments I want to forget
Texts that never got a reply
room.relation.oracles: You don't have to be good to everyone. Tonight, being good to yourself is enough.
The feelings you poured into people who were only passing through feel lighter in this fire.
"I should have said that" drifts off with the smoke.
The words that used to cut you down have burned to charcoal and gone.
room.zen.name: Late night
room.zen.caption: Time to just watch the fire and think of nothing
room.zen.rankings: Late-night worry that keeps me awake
How am I going to make a living
Tired because tomorrow will be the same
room.zen.oracles: Flames never hold on to their shape. That's why each one burns fresh.
You don't have to prove anything in front of this fire.
Stopping for a while to watch the firelight still counts as moving forward.
Yesterday is already ash. Don't let it burn up tonight too.
egg.egg_matrix.title: 💻 Matrix kernel purge
egg.egg_matrix.codeHint: Blooms when you burn developer words like bug, overtime, rm -rf, sudo or 404.
egg.egg_bull.title: 📈 Moonshot pillar of fire
egg.egg_bull.codeHint: Blooms when you burn words that wish a price higher, like to the moon, skyrocket or limit up.
egg.egg_bull.sampleTrigger: My account, limit up and to the moon
egg.egg_fireworks.title: 🎆 Resignation fireworks
egg.egg_fireworks.codeHint: Blooms when you burn words like resignation, quit my job, lottery, freedom or independence.
egg.egg_fireworks.sampleTrigger: Threw my resignation letter. Free at last
egg.egg_lightning.title: ⚡ Karma lightning
egg.egg_lightning.codeHint: Blooms when you burn words like lightning, thunderbolt, divine punishment, bad blood or revenge.
egg.egg_lightning.sampleTrigger: Lightning on everyone who made my life hell
egg.egg_sakura.title: 🌸 Cherry blossom breeze
egg.egg_sakura.codeHint: Blooms when you burn words like cherry blossom, love, spring or happiness.
egg.egg_sakura.sampleTrigger: May cherry blossoms grow where this burned
egg.egg_konami.title: 🕹️ Retro flame with 30 lives
egg.egg_konami.codeHint: That old video game code that gave you 30 lives. You can also press ↑↑↓↓←→←→BA on your keyboard's arrow keys.
egg.egg_blackhole.title: 🕳️ Event horizon
egg.egg_blackhole.codeHint: The name for the hole in space that not even light can escape.
egg.egg_blackhole.sampleTrigger: Event horizon of a black hole
egg.egg_satoshi.title: ₿ Genesis block golden hash
egg.egg_satoshi.codeHint: The name of the person who launched Bitcoin on January 3, 2009, and then disappeared.
egg.egg_sword.title: ⚔️ +99 enhancement success aura
egg.egg_sword.codeHint: The legendary enhancement level (+99) that people say costs a house's worth of money to reach, or the legendary sword itself.
egg.egg_dragon.title: 🐉 Azure dragon rising with the pearl
egg.egg_dragon.codeHint: The blue dragon that climbs into the sky holding a wishing pearl in its mouth.
egg.egg_dragon.sampleTrigger: Azure dragon rises with the wishing pearl
egg.egg_pi.title: 🌀 Pi whirlpool
egg.egg_pi.codeHint: Write pi (π) out to 10 decimal places, in digits. (3.xxxxxxxxxx)
egg.egg_42.title: 🌌 Life, the universe and everything: 42
egg.egg_42.codeHint: The answer to life, the universe and everything, which a supercomputer spent 7.5 million years working out. Just write the two digits.
egg.egg_helloworld.title: 🖥️ hello, world!
egg.egg_helloworld.codeHint: The most famous first line a program ever printed, from a 1978 book on C. Get it exact: lowercase, the comma, the space and the exclamation mark.
egg.egg_binary.title: 🤖 Machine code 01100110
egg.egg_binary.codeHint: Write f, the first letter of fire (ASCII 102), as an 8-digit binary number.
egg.egg_morse.title: 🚢 SOS in Morse code
egg.egg_morse.codeHint: The distress call ships send at sea, in Morse code. Three dots, three dashes, three dots, with spaces between: ... --- ...
egg.egg_prometheus.title: ☀️ Prometheus's first fire
egg.egg_prometheus.codeHint: The name of the Titan who brought fire to people behind Zeus's back. It only wakes when the fire is at Lv.4 or higher.
egg.egg_prometheus.failMsg: The fire is still too weak. Grow it to Lv.4 or higher, then write it again.
egg.egg_schrodinger.title: ⚛️ Quantum rift flame
egg.egg_schrodinger.codeHint: Einstein's mass-energy formula (E=mc^2), or the cat in the box that is alive and dead at the same time. It only shows up in the Nebula edge scene.
egg.egg_schrodinger.failMsg: This flame won't open on Earth. Switch the scene to Nebula edge, then write it again.
egg.egg_nirvana.title: 🪷 Temple lotus flame
egg.egg_nirvana.codeHint: The Heart Sutra line that says form is emptiness, emptiness is form. It only blooms in the Temple eaves scene.
egg.egg_nirvana.sampleTrigger: Form is emptiness, emptiness is form
egg.egg_nirvana.failMsg: This flame only blooms under the temple eaves, where the wind chime rings. Change the scene, then write it again.
egg.egg_phoenix.title: 🦅 Phoenix from the ashes
egg.egg_phoenix.codeHint: The legendary bird that is reborn from its own ashes. It only wakes when the fire is down to Lv.0 ashes.
egg.egg_phoenix.failMsg: The phoenix only wakes in the Lv.0 ashes, when the fire has nearly gone out. Leave the fire alone for about 3 minutes and it burns down to ashes.
egg.egg_creator.title: 👑 The maker's supernova
egg.egg_creator.codeHint: The nickname of Bulmeong's maker, Siru's dad. Type it as siruabba.
rank.heading: Burned most
idle.ended: Timer finished, so the sound is off.
share.text: I burned {n} things at Bulmeong tonight.
meta.desc: A virtual campfire in your browser. Listen to crackling wood and rain, write down what's weighing on you and watch it burn. Free, nothing to install.
